scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @skill-issue/server run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @skill-issue/e2e run test:e2e
